confidence_limitations: No official digest in current CKAN metadata or four tested checksum endpoints.
HEAD Content-Length matches retained local size; ETag is opaque and is not treated as a cryptographic checksum.
The retained manifest records a catalog consultation dated 2026-10-29, not a preserved HTTPS download transcript.
Independent content reconciliation covers selected presidential rows, not every byte or nonselected office in the original ZIP.

limitations: The compared ZIP digests are retained historical calculations reused by the national import; no current ZIP byte hashing was performed.
Unchanged stat fingerprints are a cache safeguard, not a cryptographic proof of unchanged ZIP bytes.
Official HTTPS transport uses the platform certificate trust store; no detached file signature or independent origin chain was verified.
The national section-vote resource has no hash field in its catalog and .zip.sha512/.zip.sha256 return 404; absence elsewhere is not asserted.
RR second-round ZIP catalog entry incorrectly points at the checksum; both resource IDs and the exact checksum filename are preserved.
No operator trust declaration, publication approval, or redistribution approval is made by this evidence report.

changes: Added RR follow-up preserving initial unsuccessful catalog lookup.
Added national-resource HEAD and two alternate checksum endpoints.
Removed general catalog boilerplate from versioned summary; response body digests retained.
Inherited text restored from original UTF-8 collection after an intermediate Windows default-encoding read; no digest or HTTP comparison was changed.
Added confidence proposals; operator trust unchanged.
